actual.label: Coherence & Cohesion
actual.summary: 分段清楚、时间线明确，概述—分述—收尾的结构完整，连接词自然且指代清晰，达到 7 分。但概述中「A 两年都最高」与第四段 C 反超 A 的数据互相矛盾，属于组织上的前后不一致；末段又与概述重复，削弱了推进感，因此不能给到 8 分。

strengths.quote: Overall, car ownership increased in all four countries over the period, although the size of the rise varied considerably.
strengths.comment: 第二段用 Overall 明确引出概述，先给总体趋势再给极端值（最高/最低），符合 Task 1 的信息组织习惯。

strengths.quote: In 2000, around 70% of households in Country A owned a car, compared with roughly 55% in Country B and about 40% in Country C.
strengths.comment: 以时间为主线分段（2000 年一段、2020 年一段），并用 compared with 把同一年份的数据横向并联，信息推进清晰。

strengths.quote: Country D also experienced significant growth, reaching around 35%, but it was still well behind the other three countries.
strengths.comment: also 承接前一句的变化，but 转折回总排名，连接词使用自然、不机械，指代（it）清楚。

issues.quote: Country A had the highest level of ownership in both years
issues.comment: 概述说 A 两年都最高，但第四段写 Country C「nearly 80%」并「overtaking Country A」，而 A 只有「about 75%」。概述与分述段落自相矛盾，破坏了全文信息的一致性。

issues.quote: In summary, while every country saw an increase, the growth was particularly striking in Country C
issues.comment: 结尾段前半句基本重复第二段概述（所有国家都增长），信息增量小；只有后半句的幅度对比是新的。整段与概述功能重叠，显得收尾冗余。

actual.label: Lexical Resource
actual.summary: 词汇量足以灵活表达趋势与差距（dramatic、almost doubled、overtaking、well behind），拼写与搭配基本准确，符合 7 分。少数指称略欠精确（把国家当作增长的百分比），但未造成理解障碍，尚未达到 8 分所需的广泛、娴熟用词。

strengths.comment: by far 强化最高级，搭配自然，是较地道的程度表达。

strengths.quote: the most dramatic change was seen in Country C, where ownership almost doubled to nearly 80%, overtaking Country A
strengths.comment: dramatic change、almost doubled、overtaking 一组词义精准，能灵活描述变化幅度与排名互换，而非只会说 increase。

strengths.quote: well behind the other three countries
strengths.comment: 用 well behind 表示差距，比简单的 lower than 更精确、更有弹性。

issues.quote: Country B had grown to approximately 65%
issues.comment: 指称不够精确：增长的是百分比/比例，不是「国家」。这类以国家名代替其数据的说法在数据描述中会显得含糊。

actual.label: Grammatical Range & Accuracy
actual.summary: 全文句子几乎无语法错误，标点规范，已出现让步从句、关系从句、分词状语、过去完成时与多种比较结构，复杂句比例不低。但整体仍以短句并列为主，句型丰富度未达到 8 分所要求的「广泛且娴熟」，故给 7.5。

strengths.quote: although the size of the rise varied considerably
strengths.comment: 让步状语从句使用正确，且置于句末，句式有变化。

strengths.quote: where ownership almost doubled to nearly 80%, overtaking Country A
strengths.comment: 非限制性关系从句加现在分词状语，结构完整、逻辑主语清楚（ownership/C 的增长），不是悬垂结构。

strengths.quote: while every country saw an increase, the growth was particularly striking in Country C
strengths.comment: while 引导的对比从句与主句搭配正确，比较结构（more modest、well behind）也使用自然。
